name: Single-offer email
description: Organize an offer around attention, relevance, benefit and action.
use_cases: Present a supported offer to an appropriate audience
structure:
Subject: [TOPIC]
Preview: [BENEFIT]

[PROBLEM]

[BENEFIT]
Optional proof: [SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE]

[DESIRED_ACTION]
Optional destination: [DESTINATION]
customization: Keep claims specific to supplied evidence; tone can be witty without fake scarcity.
limitations: AIDA is a composition heuristic, not evidence of conversion.
Sending, consent and required sender/unsubscribe details depend on the mailing context; this is a body-copy scaffold.
